description: This file declares the IRToJsonConverter and JsonIRDumper classes, which are responsible for converting intermediate representations (IR) of code structures into JSON format. It is part of a header-checker tool that serializes IR data such as types, functions, and global variables into JSON.

classes.name: IRToJsonConverter
classes.description: Provides static methods for converting various IR types and structures into JSON objects.

classes.name: JsonIRDumper
classes.description: A class that extends IRDumper to facilitate dumping IR modules as JSON files, utilizing IRToJsonConverter methods.

methods.name: AddTemplateInfo
methods.description: Adds template information to a JSON object representing a type declaration.

methods.name: AddTypeInfo
methods.description: Adds type info to a JSON object for a given TypeIR.

methods.name: AddRecordFields
methods.description: Adds record (struct/class) fields to a JSON object.

methods.name: AddBaseSpecifiers
methods.description: Adds base class specifiers to a record type JSON object.

methods.name: AddVTableLayout
methods.description: Adds virtual table layout info to a record type JSON object.

methods.name: AddEnumFields
methods.description: Adds enum fields to a JSON object.

methods.name: AddFunctionParametersAndSetReturnType
